stories.title: Revert dev fallback that hides SMTP failures
stories.acceptance_criteria: When sendVerificationEmail throws in resendVerificationEmail, ALWAYS rethrow. Remove linkLoggedToConsole return. Never return success when email did not send.

stories.title: SMTP configuration logging on startup
stories.acceptance_criteria: On server start: log if SMTP configured (host, port) or NOT configured. No silent state.

stories.title: Rate limit must not block email send
stories.acceptance_criteria: If audit_log rate limit query fails, allow send (fail open). Ensure rate limit logic does not prevent legitimate sends.

stories.title: Signup must surface email failures
stories.acceptance_criteria: On venue signup: if sendVerificationEmail throws, log and surface error. Do not silently swallow. User knows email failed.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: Build passes. With SMTP: emails deliver. Without SMTP: clear error, no fake success.
